instruction: Find the 2021 AFC Championship game results.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from NFL.com homepage to the 2021 AFC Championship game (POST3 = Conference Championship). Similar to original Super Bowl task - navigating to a specific playoff round for a given year. Uses is_expected_url_pattern_match for URL verification.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction: user must navigate to the 2021 AFC Championship game results page
Getter (active_url_from_accessTree) correctly extracts the active Chrome tab URL from accessibility tree
Metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match) correctly uses regex to match URL against expected pattern
Expected URL pattern 'https://www\.nfl\.com/scores/2021/POST3' is semantically correct for the 2021 AFC Championship game (POST3 = Conference Championship round)
Complete coverage: URL verification is sufficient for this navigation task
Data flow is correct: URL string from getter matches metric's expected input format (handles both string and dict)
No postconfig needed: Chrome remains open and URL is accessible via accessibility tree
Semantic compatibility verified: all components work together correctly to verify task completion
